scenarios.name: a delivery that takes time holds the stream; a held relay write limits the carrier
the direct path is offered, answered, validated and carries the stream
the direct path stalls, falls back to the relay and tries again one window later
a path that never opens times out
a path whose message size is too small is never offered again
a missing peer host or a refused offer retries once per window
the ICE set that cannot be resolved or parsed is offered empty
an ICE set that does not parse is offered empty
a restart close names the newest offer; stale names are ignored; the previous offer is kept for one window
a suspend close from the phone stops new peers until it asks for a restart
a peer that fails reports its reason; a TURN path is counted
an answer the peer refuses closes the attempt; a peer that refuses a send keeps the record
signals the coordinator cannot accept
a refused peer send keeps the record for the next flush
